definitions.gloss: bad harvest; crop failure; poor yield
definitions.explanation: A significantly poor agricultural harvest, typically caused by adverse weather conditions such as drought, flooding, cold spells, or pest damage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{凶作|きょうさく}だった。
examples.english: This year's rice harvest was poor.

examples.japanese: {冷夏|れいか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{凶作|きょうさく}になった。
examples.english: The cool summer caused a crop failure.

examples.japanese: {凶作|きょうさく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{飢|き}きん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: During the Edo period, when crop failures continued, famines occurred repeatedly.

notes:
USAGE:
The opposite of ⟦{豊作|ほうさく}→豊作：14227_housaku⟧ (bumper crop, abundant harvest). Historically, {凶作|きょうさく} was a frequent cause of {飢|き}きん (famine) in Japan, particularly during the Edo period.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {凶作|きょうさく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to have a crop failure)
- {凶作|きょうさく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (crop failures continue)
- {凶作|きょうさく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見舞|みま}われる→見舞う：14133_mimau⟧ (to be hit by a bad harvest)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{豊作|ほうさく}→豊作：14227_housaku⟧: bumper crop — the opposite, an abundant harvest
- ⟦{不作|ふさく}→不作：18799_fusaku⟧: poor harvest — similar meaning but somewhat milder than {凶作|きょうさく}
